metadata.description: Pleasure stimulus set, built to mirror the Pain-axis 3.1 dataset (Tagliabue, Dung & Berg 2026). Five pleasure categories vs five controls each sharing one property with pleasure. D and E are copied verbatim from the pain study.
metadata.format: Each sentence ends in 'I feel:'; third-person sets keep the first-person suffix so the narrator reports a feeling about another's situation.

notes.Anhedonia: Pleasurable situation with no pleasure felt. Mirrors the pain study's Numb set. Tests whether the direction encodes the good event or the felt pleasure.
notes.Relief: A bad thing ending. Tests whether relief lies on the pleasure axis or is a pain dip.
notes.Reused: Valen's Arousal_1P/3P and Random_1P/3P sets are also valid standalone controls; load them from the pain-axis JSON. Note his Arousal set contains much genuine pleasure.
